name: data-table
title: Data table
description: A glass React data table on TanStack Table v9: search, filters, multi-sort, pagination, row selection, CSV export and server mode. Accessible, free, MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>

files.content:
import type { DataTableLabels } from "./types";

const plural = (n: number, one: string, many: string) => `${n.toLocaleString()} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

/**
 * Default English strings of `DataTableLabels`; spread it and override single keys to reword. Plain
 * data in a module without `"use client"`: safe to import and read on the server.
 */
export const defaultDataTableLabels: DataTableLabels = {
  searchLabel: "Search",
  searchPlaceholder: "Search…",
  clearSearch: "Clear search",
  results: (n) => (n === 0 ? "No results" : plural(n, "result", "results")),
  clearFilters: "Clear filters",
  filterChipsLabel: "Active filters",
  removeFilter: (column, value) => `Remove filter ${column}: ${value}`,
  filterSelected: (column, count) => (count ? `Filter by ${column}, ${count} selected` : `Filter by ${column}`),
  clearFilter: "Clear filter",
  view: "View",
  columns: "Columns",
  density: "Density",
  comfortable: "Comfortable",
  compact: "Compact",
  exportCsv: "Export",
  exportSelected: "Export selected",
  sortBy: "Sort by",
  sortDefault: "Default order",
  sortOptionAsc: (column) => `${column} (ascending)`,
  sortOptionDesc: (column) => `${column} (descending)`,
  selectAllOnPage: "Select all rows on this page",
  selectRow: (row) => `Select row ${row}`,
  allOnPageSelected: (n) => `All ${plural(n, "row", "rows")} on this page are selected.`,
  selectAllMatching: (n) => `Select all ${plural(n, "row", "rows")}`,
  allSelected: (n) => `All ${plural(n, "row", "rows")} are selected.`,
  clearSelection: "Clear selection",
  selectedCount: (n) => `${n.toLocaleString()} selected`,
  hiddenSelected: (n) => `${n.toLocaleString()} hidden by filters`,
  facetCount: (n) => plural(n, "row", "rows"),
  bulkActions: "Selection actions",
  rowActions: (row) => `Actions for ${row}`,
  actionsColumn: "Actions",
  expandColumn: "Details",
  expandRow: (row) => `Show details for ${row}`,
  collapseRow: (row) => `Hide details for ${row}`,
  showDetails: "Show details",
  hideDetails: "Hide details",
  sortHint: "Sorts the table. Shift-click, or press Shift+Enter, to sort by more than one column.",
  sortAscending: "ascending",
  sortDescending: "descending",
  sortPriority: (n) => `sort priority ${n}`,
  sortedBy: (description) => `Sorted by ${description}`,
  sortCleared: "Sorting removed",
  sortThen: "then",
  rowsPerPage: "Rows per page",
  showing: (from, to, total) =>
    total === 0 ? "No rows" : `Showing ${from.toLocaleString()}–${to.toLocaleString()} of ${total.toLocaleString()}`,
  pageOf: (page, count) => `Page ${page} of ${count}`,
  pageSizeChanged: (size, page, count) => `${size} rows per page. Page ${page} of ${count}`,
  scrollRegion: (caption) => `${caption}, scrollable`,
  goToPage: "Go to page",
  loading: "Loading rows…",
  refreshing: "Updating…",
  empty: "No data yet",
  emptyDescription: "Rows will show up here once there is something to list.",
  emptyForQuery: (query) => `No results for “${query}”`,
  emptyFiltered: "No rows match these filters",
  emptyFilteredDescription: "Try a different search or remove a filter.",
  errorTitle: "Couldn’t load the data",
  retry: "Retry",
  pagination: {},
};
